rationale: The Latin anchor *levare* ("to lift, raise") most directly corresponds to raising something from a lower to a higher position (raise.v.02), while *auferre* ("to carry away/off") adds a nuance of removal. In context, a-wegan refers to physically lifting/raising, making raise.v.02 the closest match over lift.v.02, which emphasizes moving to a different location rather than upward motion.
